base_source: TTM attributable owner's earnings from EDGAR: FY2025 net income available to common stockholders $984M - H1 2025 $437M + H1 2026 $579M = $1,126M / 448.37M diluted shares (Q1 2026, split-adjusted) = $2.51. Engine OCF-based base ($19.75 median / $35.36 latest) rejected: broker-dealer OCF is client-balance plumbing and consolidated NI is 77% noncontrolling interest (IBG LLC). See analysis.md.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 35.36 vs 3-yr median 19.75 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 6.3x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
DILUTION: share count growing 63.6%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits banks/insurers poorly; grade confidence low
moat_justification: Automation-driven structural cost advantage (77% pretax margin), 170+ market breadth and pro/institutional workflow switching costs, margin/securities-lending scale flywheel, through-cycle profitability — against no mass-retail brand moat, Robinhood/Public margin-rate compression, earnings geared to policy rates (NIM 2.07% to 1.93% YoY) and trading volumes, and founder/Up-C concentration.
name: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc.
one_liner: Elite automated broker, moat 7/10 — but the engine's Tier S is an artifact (consolidated NI is 77% noncontrolling interest; broker OCF is client plumbing); on attributable TTM earnings of $2.51/share the $87.89 price (35x) yields a 9.8% weighted IRR, IV@15% $46.23 — clears 15% only at ~$46 (~$37 with a margin of safety).
